limitations: Synthetic fixture acceptance establishes arithmetic/software behavior, never biological or physical validity.
Content hashes cannot prove historical freeze timing, actual acquisition availability or real source independence.

The conservative English whole-word prefix gate with \w* uses caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*; also biomarker*, pathway*, identif*, compound identity, truth and physical validity. It is incomplete and requires independent source review.
Within-batch pooled QC participate in their own running-median correction; reduced RSD is not held-out efficacy.
Median normalization uses all positive corrected features before filtering; variable distance-coordinate counts are not directly comparable.
Two-group batch overlap is a limited confounding flag, not proof that the design is otherwise unconfounded.
Independent review and rigor classification remain unavailable and coordinator-owned.
